produces.name: Tomatoes
produces.description: A juicy, versatile fruit used as a vegetable in almost every Pakistani kitchen, from curries to salads.
produces.growingProcess: Grown from seedlings in warm, sunny fields and harvested once they ripen to a deep red.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked in the early morning and brought to market the same day to stay fresh.

produces.name: Spinach
produces.description: A leafy green packed with iron, commonly cooked into palak saag.
produces.growingProcess: Grown in cooler months from seed, ready to harvest in just a few weeks.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Bundled at the farm and delivered fresh within a day of picking.

produces.name: Carrots
produces.description: A crunchy root vegetable eaten raw, in salads, or cooked into gajar ka halwa.
produces.growingProcess: Grown underground in loose, sandy soil over a full growing season.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Pulled, washed, and bunched at the farm before being trucked to local markets.

produces.name: Potatoes
produces.description: A kitchen staple used in nearly every style of Pakistani cooking.
produces.growingProcess: Grown from seed potatoes planted in mounded soil and harvested once the plants die back.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Stored briefly at the farm, then sacked and delivered in bulk to markets.

produces.name: Mint
produces.description: A fragrant herb central to chutneys, raita, and iced drinks.
produces.growingProcess: Grown in moist soil or containers, spreading quickly from cuttings.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Cut fresh and bundled the same morning it's sold, since it wilts quickly.

produces.name: Coriander
produces.description: A bright, citrusy herb used as a garnish and flavor base in most Pakistani dishes.
produces.growingProcess: Grown from seed in cooler weather and harvested while the leaves are still tender.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Bunched at the farm and kept in damp cloth to stay fresh for market.

produces.name: Mangoes
produces.description: Pakistan's most celebrated fruit, prized for its sweetness during the summer season.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on orchard trees over several months, ripening fully in the summer heat.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Hand-picked at peak ripeness and transported quickly to avoid bruising.

produces.name: Kinnow
produces.description: A juicy, easy-to-peel citrus variety especially popular in Punjab during winter.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on citrus trees over a long season, sweetening as winter approaches.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Harvested by hand and crated for transport to markets across the country.

produces.name: Bananas
produces.description: A year-round, energy-rich fruit sold individually or by the dozen.
produces.growingProcess: Grown in warm, humid regions and harvested in large bunches while still green.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Ripened along the way to market so they arrive ready to eat.

produces.name: Guava
produces.description: A fragrant, slightly tart fruit popular fresh or sprinkled with spice mix.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on small trees and harvested by hand once the skin turns pale green-yellow.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked just before full ripeness so it holds up during transport.

produces.name: Milk
produces.description: Fresh cow or buffalo milk, a daily household essential.
produces.growingProcess: Sourced from dairy farms with daily milking routines.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Collected each morning and delivered in chilled containers the same day.

produces.name: Yogurt
produces.description: A tangy, creamy staple used in raita, lassi, and everyday meals.
produces.growingProcess: Made by culturing fresh milk with a starter until it thickens naturally.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Set in small batches and kept cool until it reaches the market stall.

produces.name: Wheat
produces.description: Pakistan's staple grain, ground into flour for roti and naan.
produces.growingProcess: Sown in winter and harvested in early summer once the stalks turn golden.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Threshed at the farm, bagged, and sold in bulk to local mills and markets.

produces.name: Honey
produces.description: Raw, unprocessed honey harvested from local beekeepers.
produces.growingProcess: Produced by bee colonies kept near flowering fields and orchards.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Extracted from the comb and jarred close to where it's harvested.

produces.name: Free-Range Eggs
produces.description: Eggs from hens raised outdoors rather than in cages.
produces.growingProcess: Laid daily by hens that roam and feed freely on small farms.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Collected daily and carried to market in trays to keep them from cracking.

produces.name: Turnips
produces.description: A mild, slightly peppery root vegetable often paired with winter greens.
produces.growingProcess: Grown in cool soil through the winter months and pulled once the roots mature.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Harvested by hand, washed, and bundled for same-day delivery to market.

produces.name: Watermelon
produces.description: A refreshing, water-rich fruit that's a summer favorite across Pakistan.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on sprawling vines in hot weather, taking a full summer to ripen.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked once fully ripe and transported by truck given how quickly it needs to reach market.

produces.name: Cucumber
produces.description: A cool, crisp vegetable eaten raw in salads or as a refreshing summer side.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on climbing vines in warm weather and harvested while still young and tender.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked frequently through the season and delivered fresh within a day.

produces.name: Peaches
produces.description: A soft, fragrant stone fruit with a short but much-loved summer season.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on orchard trees, ripening over the peak summer months.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Hand-picked carefully to avoid bruising, then delivered quickly to nearby markets.

produces.name: Pomegranate
produces.description: A jewel-seeded fruit prized for its juice and its use in salads and chutneys.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on hardy shrubs, ripening as the weather cools into autumn.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Harvested by hand once the skin hardens and delivered in crates to avoid damage.

produces.name: Sweet Potatoes
produces.description: A naturally sweet root vegetable, often roasted or boiled as a warming autumn dish.
produces.growingProcess: Grown underground through the warm months and harvested as autumn begins.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Dug up, cured briefly at the farm, then sacked for delivery to market.

produces.name: Persimmon
produces.description: A honey-sweet fruit that ripens into a soft, glowing orange treat in autumn.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on deciduous trees, ripening fully just as the leaves begin to fall.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked at the right ripeness stage and carefully crated for transport.

produces.name: Strawberries
produces.description: A bright, sweet berry that signals the start of spring.
produces.growingProcess: Grown low to the ground on small plants, ripening quickly in mild spring weather.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked by hand every couple of days and rushed to market given how delicate they are.

produces.name: Green Peas
produces.description: Small, sweet peas enjoyed fresh in pulao and everyday curries.
produces.growingProcess: Grown on climbing vines through the cooler spring months.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Picked while still tender and delivered in pods to keep them fresh longer.

produces.name: Radishes
produces.description: A crisp, peppery root vegetable often eaten raw with salt as a simple side.
produces.growingProcess: Grown quickly in loose soil, ready to harvest just weeks after planting.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Pulled, rinsed, and bundled at the farm on the morning of market day.

produces.name: Lettuce
produces.description: A crunchy leafy green that forms the base of most fresh salads.
produces.growingProcess: Grown in mild spring temperatures, which keep the leaves tender rather than bitter.
produces.howItReachesMarket: Cut just before market day since it wilts quickly once harvested.
